lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately 5 distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a defined geometric grid on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient and running horizontally from the branchial region towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of faint, high-luminance blobs is visible primarily along the basal region of the first dorsal fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral area inferior to the pectoral fin and near the branchial openings.
